instruction: Expand the first table in the document by adding two columns to its right side.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.press("down", presses=40, interval=0.01); time.sleep(1); pyautogui.scroll(-2)
import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task asks user to add 2 new columns to the right side of the first table. Original table has 11 rows and 7 columns. After adding 2 columns, the table should have 11 rows and 9 columns. Evaluator verifies the first table has exactly 11 rows and 9 columns.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator correctly verifies the table has 11 rows and 9 columns (original 7 + 2 added = 9)
Correct getter logic: Extracts table dimensions from docx file using python-docx library, focusing on first table
Correct metric logic: Compares both rows and columns dimensions, returns 1.0 only if both match exactly
Correct expected values: 11 rows (unchanged) and 9 columns (7 + 2) semantically match the instruction requirement
Proper postconfig: Saves document with Ctrl+S to ensure changes are persisted before verification
Correct data flow: Getter extracts dimensions -> Metric receives and compares -> Expected values are accurate
Edge case handling: Getter handles missing tables and empty results appropriately
